name: The Standing Ovation
flavor: The applause outlived the audience. It is a churning mass of hands, and it is coming down the aisle.
acNote: there is nothing solid to hit

attacks.name: Applause
attacks.note: Half as much (1d6) while the swarm is at half its hit points or fewer.

features.name: A Swarm of Hands
features.description: It takes half damage from bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. It can move through any opening a hand fits through, it can enter and end its turn in another creature's space, and it cannot be grappled, restrained or knocked prone.

features.name: Deafening
features.description: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is deafened until the end of its next turn — and a deafened creature cannot take reactions, which means it cannot Parry.

tactics: It goes where the party is thickest and stays there. Everything a sword does to it is halved, so it exists to be the fight where somebody's odd trick — a burst, a fire, an illusion — is suddenly the right answer. It never retreats. Applause does not.
narration: The sound arrives a half second before it does, and once you are inside it you cannot hear the person shouting at you from four feet away.
